## Validation

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] Packaged/frozen behavior was checked when it differs from source execution.
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded under `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]`.

## Safety and provenance

- [ ] No credentials, prompts, completions, private code, caches, or model weights are included.
- [ ] Third-party licenses, notices, authorship, and immutable revisions are preserved.
- [ ] Persistent changes have a documented rollback and preserve unrelated user state.
